title: The Judges of the Land of Israel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: They are Rabbi Ami and Rabbi Assi, as in [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.5). In [Bava Batra 70b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.70b.2) they said: “Shall we say it is the dispute of these Tannaim, as it was taught: The judges of the Diaspora say he swears; the judges of the Land of Israel say,” etc. Hyman calls the words “of these Tannaim, as it was taught” a printing error, and [Tosafot on Ketubot 92b](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Ketubot.92b.2.1), s.v. Dinah, copied it correctly.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bava Batra includes “of these Tannaim, as it was taught.” The linked Tosafot quotes the two groups of judges and omits that wording. Hyman argues that it entered the printed text in error.
